simple.meaning: אוּזָל (ʼÛwzâl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Uzal , a son of Joktan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אוּזָל (H187) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:27, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוּזָל (H187) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אוּזָל (H187) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אוּזָל (ʼÛwzâl) / H187 is traced through Genesis 10:27, 1 Chronicles 1:21, Ezekiel 27:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H187. Uzal אוּזָל proper name, masculine (Samaritan ᵐ5 איזל, Αἰζηλ ) 6th son of Joktan Gen 10:27 ; 1Chr 1:21 = proper name, of a location Ezek 27:19 , read ᵑ6 ᵐ5 מֵאוּזָל Hi Sm Co; old capital of Yemen, later San'â , compare Di Gen 10:27 . I. אזן ( pointed, sharp ? compare Ethiopic edge, corner, peak, pinnacle ; see also Assyrian Dl W , & אָזֵן below)
